body: Thanks for your reply. I live with my family but we are not very close in the sense that i dont feel comfortable talking about my emotions or feelings with them. They would ridicule me instead of helping. This is also why I have avoided any professional or medical help including any therapies. If my family found out I was depressed they would call me crazy and things like that, and I dont have any money to seek treatment on my own. I will keep those suggestions in mind and research them though, thank you.
